description: Runs a full Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) audit on a URL: crawlability (30pts), content structure for AI extraction (35pts), and E-E-A-T trust signals (35pts), plus llms.txt and AI-bot access checks. Returns a 0-100 score, sub-scores, a verdict, and prioritized, actionable recommendations.

url.description: Full URL of the page to audit, e.g. https://example.com/page

name: audit_aeo
